summary: Architect, architectural engineer and PMP-certified construction and project management professional with 20+ years across construction monitoring, site supervision, QA/QC, design review, public-sector rehabilitation, procurement support, contract administration, EU-funded programme coordination and built heritage. Sole in-house Construction Engineer at UNICEF Bosnia and Herzegovina for an EU IPA 2020-funded portfolio of 17 preschool facilities and seven Centres for Social Work, including WASH, accessibility, energy efficiency and solar components.
core_competencies: Bills of Quantities and Cost Estimates

experience.title: Construction Engineer, Operations Section
bullets: Sole in-house Construction Engineer for a multi-site EU IPA 2020-funded rehabilitation portfolio: 17 preschools and 7 Centres for Social Work, including WASH, accessibility, energy efficiency and solar components.
Provided technical governance for a construction portfolio valued at approximately USD 3 million.

Reviewed designs, drawings, specifications, bills of quantities, cost estimates, schedules, method statements, material submittals and permits for coherence, constructability and procurement readiness.
Prepared and reviewed terms of reference, scopes of work, technical specifications, tender documents and evaluation criteria; handled bidder clarifications and contributed to technical evaluations.

Led construction monitoring and QA/QC: site visits, progress meetings, inspection and hold points, non-conformities, defect tracking and remedial-action follow-up; monitored occupational health and safety and escalated risks.
Verified interim payment applications, measured quantities, progress certificates and retention; reviewed variation orders, claims and extensions of time.
Maintained risk registers, issue logs, payment trackers and defect lists; prepared technical reports, Notes for Record, minutes and management briefings.
Acted as Release Officer in SAP/VISION for financial transactions and contract management.
Coordinated Programme, Supply, Operations and Finance teams with ministries, municipalities, beneficiaries, contractors, consultants and supervision companies.
Managed completion, handover, as-built documentation, warranties, Defects Liability Period monitoring and contract close-out.

experience.title: Rehabilitation Architect and Construction Consultant
bullets: Carried out condition assessments and prepared rehabilitation proposals, technical descriptions, specifications, scopes of work and cost documentation.
Advised clients on adaptive reuse, compatible materials and rehabilitation methods for existing buildings.
